notes: Questions are written against passages read out of the index, then phrased in words the passage does not use wherever the subject allows it. That is the weakness to keep in mind when reading a score: the questions were written after seeing the answers, so this measures ranking, not discovery. Anchors are verbatim fragments of the answering chunk; resolution happens at run time, so a re-ingest that changes chunking reports unresolvable questions rather than silently scoring them as misses. The five questions that targeted EPUB and PowerPoint documents were removed on 2026-08-13 with those readers; scores from before that date were measured over 56 questions and 14 documents and are NOT comparable to these. The corpus lost three novels, one of them Spanish against an English-only embedding model, so the remaining set is easier as well as smaller.
